agents.name: Field Extractor
agents.description: Pulls line items, tax, PO numbers, and due dates from PDF and email invoices.

agents.name: Total Validator
agents.description: Reconciles subtotals, tax math, and currency against tolerance rules.

agents.name: Vendor Matcher
agents.description: Links invoices to vendor master records and flags duplicate submissions.

agents.name: Approval Router
agents.description: Applies spend policies and routes invoices to the right approver chain.

agents.name: Exception Handler
agents.description: Explains rejects, gathers missing fields, and drafts vendor clarification emails.
